incident-bot: PAGER - oncall @maya - inference-runtime: spike in 502/503 errors in us-east-1 (5m avg ~6%). Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/rt-errors

maya: seeing it now, thanks. concurrent 95th p50 token latency also up. paging sanjay for capacity ops.

sanjay: i'm awake, joining. any customer-facing outages reported?

cs-lead: a couple customers reported API timeouts, one enterprise account (acme-inc) seeing 40% failure rate on generate API. CS opened a bridge.

maya: quick triage: errors originate from runtime queue saturation - lots of long-running streaming requests. suspect stale long-polling / slow clients.

eli: oncall note: logs show backlog of inflight requests > max_inflight for several nodes, KVS cache misses causing token-generation stalls.

kai: suggest immediate live mitigation: reduce max_inflight from 200 -> 80 on us-east pool and enable shedding for streaming endpoints. That should drop concurrency pressure.

maya: agree. plan: 1) apply max_inflight change 2) enable streaming-shed mode (reject with 429 for non-essential streaming) 3) tighten upstream timeouts (15s -> 10s) 4) emergency per-tenant quota throttle for noisy tenants.

sanjay: i'm going to run the shaper change now. issuing command:
```bash
# scale down in-flight concurrency for pool us-east-1
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool us-east-1 --max-inflight 80
```

ops-bot: ACTION - runtime-config-change submitted by sanjay. Change ID: cfg-7891. Rolling to 6 nodes.

maya: enabling streaming shed rule: non-critical streaming endpoints will return 429 with Retry-After. Code toggle: feature.streaming_shed = true.

eli: applying timeout tweak on the router layer:
```yaml
router:
  request_timeout_seconds: 10
  upstream_idle_timeout_seconds: 8
```

kai: also applying an emergency per-tenant soft limit for top noisy tenants: 30 rps/tenant. Command: `redwoodctl quota set --tenant acme-inc --rps 30 --reason "emergency shedding"`

ops-bot: QUOTA CHANGE - tenant acme-inc set to 30 rps by kai (cfg-7892). Notifying billing/cs.

maya: initial results: error rate dropping to ~2.1% in 90s, p95 latency improving. still seeing a few unhealthy nodes being slower.

cs-lead: acme-inc on bridge says errors reduced, but some users still see partial responses. they ask for ETA on full recovery.

maya: ETA 15-20m to stabilize. we're rolling mitigation across us-east. I'm going to handoff in 25m to sanjay for monitoring once changes finish.

sanjay: i'll take the 2nd half of the incident. will keep the bridge open and coordinate with infra to drain a couple slow VMs.

eli: follow-up action item: add a rule to auto-shed streaming requests when queue_depth > 0.85 and fallback to non-streaming variant. Filed GH: redwood/runtime#5432.

kai: ops note: we should add a short-circuit for long-poll clients older than 2.1.0 — they don't send heartbeats and cause head-of-line blocking.

maya: agree, create rollout ticket and include in postmortem. For now we will keep streaming_shed on and monitor impact for 1 hour, then gradually relax if stable.

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026 created from this thread. Severity: sev2. Owners: maya, sanjay, eli.

maya: handing over to @sanjay for watch. i'm pausing my notifications for 20m (bathroom break) — ping if things regress. :thumbsup:

sanjay: taking over. will update this thread every 5m with metrics snapshot.

(5m later)
sanjay: metrics update: errors 0.9% -> target under 1%. p95 latency back to baseline. keeping streaming_shed and reduced max_inflight for another 30m pending postmortem.

eli: postmortem TODOs: "add auto-shed heuristic", "add per-tenant noisy-client detector", "improve dashboard alert thresholds to trigger earlier".

cs-lead: CS will follow up with acme-inc with mitigation summary and ETA for root cause writeup.

maya: closing loop: will write incident summary and attach config diffs (cfg-7891, cfg-7892). Great response team. :clap:

sanjay: agreed. sending short retrospective to #postmortems in 2 hours.
